author: doctorligma69
quote: Played for 12 hours just doing story, the first 7 hours are extremely underwhelming, a large portion of play time (around half) was spent playing a glorified relationship simulator, buy flowers, fix the stairs, repair the wall, paint the wall, fix the leaky roof, etc, the kind of stuff that might be fun if you're into relationship sim or life sim type games, but that's not what this series is about. So far only one single mission was actually fun and engaging (escaping from the hospital) and then afterwards you're stuck doing about 4 hours of more boring relationship slog and generic "make money" missions.
